card.name: Citation numbers after a sentence
card.fires_on: The first digit of a superscript reference number placed right after a sentence-ending period, as in 1-4 or 27-29. It also appears on author affiliation numbers and numbered claim references.

modes.label: Reference numbers after sentences
modes.description: A citation number that has been run into the text after a full stop, often the start of a range.
